name: Bicycle

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Main frame triangle, seat tube, seatpost, saddle: hollow steel/aluminum tubes. Mass spread along tube network; narrow laterally (small x-extent) so low x-variance. CoM slightly forward-low near BB junction.
parts.inertiaFrame: Scene axes, at estimated center of mass; center position in scene coordinates (reference frame).
parts.inertiaBasis: Diagonal approximation from Qwen-estimated mass distribution: Main frame triangle, seat tube, seatpost, saddle: hollow steel/aluminum tubes. Mass spread along tube network; narrow laterally (small x-extent) so low x-variance. CoM slightly forward-low near BB junction.

parts.name: steering
parts.massBasis: Handlebars, stem, headset, and fork: hollow aluminum/steel tubes. Mass distributed along fork legs and bar; CoM biased upward toward handlebars. Hollow tube construction reduces variance vs solid.
parts.inertiaFrame: Scene axes, at estimated center of mass; center position in scene coordinates (reference frame).
parts.inertiaBasis: Diagonal approximation from Qwen-estimated mass distribution: Handlebars, stem, headset, and fork: hollow aluminum/steel tubes. Mass distributed along fork legs and bar; CoM biased upward toward handlebars. Hollow tube construction reduces variance vs solid.

parts.name: rear wheel roll
parts.massBasis: Rear wheel with cassette/freewheel adds axial mass vs front. Ring geometry dominates radial inertia; cassette widens x-extent slightly raising x-variance. Heavier than front due to drivetrain hardware.
parts.inertiaFrame: Scene axes, at estimated center of mass; center position in scene coordinates (reference frame).

parts.name: crank spin
parts.massBasis: Crankset with chainrings, pedals, and BB: solid aluminum/steel rotating parts; mass concentrated near center with arms extending radially. Slightly lower CoM due to chainring weight below BB axis.
parts.inertiaFrame: Scene axes, at estimated center of mass; center position in scene coordinates (reference frame).

parts.name: front wheel roll
parts.massBasis: Front wheel: tire, rim, spokes, hub. Thin-shell/ring geometry concentrates mass at rim radius → high y,z variance near ring limit; very thin axially (x) → low x-variance. Symmetric about hub.
